description: This Java test class verifies the behavior of the ModifyConnection class, including JSON serialization/deserialization, equality, immutability, and resource path retrieval in the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.connectivity.modify package.

classes.name: ModifyConnectionTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the ModifyConnection functionality in the package, including JSON serialization/deserialization, equality, immutability, and resource path correctness.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the hashCode and equals implementations for the ModifyConnection class using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that instances of ModifyConnection and related Connection and MappingContext are immutable.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullConnection
methods.description: Ensures that passing null Connection to ModifyConnection.of() throws NullPointerException with appropriate message.

methods.name: fromJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that creating a ModifyConnection from JSON produces the expected object.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the JSON representation of ModifyConnection matches the expected JSON structure.

methods.name: getResourcePathReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that getResourcePath() returns an empty JSON pointer.
